duplicate_investigation.method: exact full-row duplicate detection across all 42 columns
duplicate_investigation.pattern_found: Duplicated rows occur as contiguous BLOCKS reappearing at a near-constant row-index offset (most commonly 17, 19, 20, or 22 rows apart), e.g. rows 240-251 reappear verbatim at rows 259-270. This is the signature of a copy/append error during data export, not independent respondents who coincidentally answered identically across 39 columns.
duplicate_investigation.recommendation: Exclude rows where is_duplicate_secondary == true from statistical analysis and model training. Do NOT delete them from the stored dataset -- keep them flagged for traceability in case the original data collection team needs to verify against source records.
